default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-858.title: VWAP deviation z-score band fade
E-858.hypothesis: Price stretched several standard deviations from VWAP (measured on its own recent deviation) is pushed by impatient flow; liquidity providers fade it back toward VWAP.

E-859.title: Bollinger squeeze expansion break
E-859.hypothesis: When band width is far below its usual level for the time of day, volatility is compressed; the first close outside the band signals the release direction.

E-860.title: MACD histogram sign flip
E-860.hypothesis: A flip of the MACD histogram marks momentum changing hands between short and long horizon traders; follow the new sign.

E-861.title: Donchian midpoint cross with rising mid
E-861.hypothesis: A close crossing the middle of the N-minute high/low channel while the channel midpoint already drifts the same way shows value migrating; follow it.

E-862.title: Dollar lead, index lag
E-862.hypothesis: WIN and the dollar are inversely linked; when the dollar has moved much more than the index implies, index traders lag arbitrageurs and WIN catches up.

E-863.title: EMA ribbon alignment onset
E-863.hypothesis: Close above a stack of rising-order EMAs (n, 2n, 4n) means all horizons agree; the first bar of alignment starts a trend leg.

E-864.title: Late-session stretch back to VWAP
E-864.hypothesis: Near the close, day traders and funds flatten books; a large stretch from VWAP relative to the day's range tends to be pulled back as positions are squared.

E-865.title: CCI extreme re-entry fade
E-865.hypothesis: When CCI falls back inside +-threshold after an extreme, the stretch has stopped extending and late momentum chasers are trapped; fade.

E-866.title: DI cross with trend-strength filter
E-866.hypothesis: A +DI/-DI cross while directional movement is already strong (high ADX-like reading) indicates that the stronger side keeps control.

E-867.title: Opening-range midpoint cross
E-867.hypothesis: After the opening range ends, the range midpoint is the balance point; a close crossing it shows the opening auction's winner and drives the day's side.
